{{Quote|You are preparing a course for Fendrilon Koozar, yes?''"<br />"''Yes. He has ordered an appetizer of raw Wroonian flycatcher filet, followed by a bowl of sufar greens topped with mecolar briddlings and drezzle sauce, then a main dish of fleek-eel broiled in zaffa oil. He has not yet placed his order for dessert.''"<br />"''You will ensure he is given the 'house special.'|Guri and Tavvar Va'ran|<ref name="A Very Special Meal" />}}
[[Master Chef]] '''Tavvar Va'ran''' was the second-best [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], though few knew that [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] himself retained the [[Unidentified Kubaz chef|best Kubaz chef]] for his personal staff. Va'ran worked at the [[Manarai]] [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] most exclusive fine-dining venue for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] high society, but his employment came with a dangerous catch. He had been personally hired by Manarai co-owner [[Guri]], which left Va'ran indebted to Guri's master&mdash;[[Dark Prince|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], [[Underlord|leader]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate.

In [[3 ABY|3.5 ABY]], Va'ran nervously obeyed Guri's order to secretly [[Death/Legends|murder]] [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Fendrilon Koozar]] for prying into Black Sun's business. To carry out the deed, Va'ran [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] Koozar's meal one busy [[Standard day/Legends|night]] at the Manarai with a combination of natural ingredients and untraceable chemicals designed to produce a painful death some [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] after eating. Va'ran learned the following evening that his recipe worked as planned, as Koozar had killed himself after throwing a hallucinatory fit and crashing his luxury [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] in a [[Fire/Legends|fiery]] explosion.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Do you have any particular preparation instructions you would like me to follow?''"<br />"''I am looking for something discreet, as always. Perhaps a recipe to induce hallucinatory effects later on&mdash;something that might prompt him to open his speeder door and leap out, or jump from his tower balcony.''"<br />"''It will be done according to your orders.|Tavvar Va'ran and Guri|<ref name="A Very Special Meal" />}}
Tavvar Va'ran worked as [[Master Chef]] at the [[Manarai]],<ref name="A Very Special Meal" /> the most exclusive [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Capital/Legends|throneworld]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and the premier gathering place for the Imperial Center elite.<ref name="SOTE">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> Va'ran was the second-best [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] in the Empire, though few knew that the [[Unidentified Kubaz chef|best Kubaz chef]] was actually on [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] personal staff. While usually only responsible for creating the restaurant's fine culinary delights, Va'ran ultimately answered to the demands of the woman who had personally hired him: [[Guri]], part-owner of the Manarai<ref name="A Very Special Meal" /> and chief [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] to [[Dark Prince|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], [[Underlord|leader]] of the powerful [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate.<ref name="SOTE" />

[[File:GuriStatuesque-SOTETC.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Guri, who Tavvar Va'ran answered to, and her boss, Prince Xizor; both co-owners of the Manarai]]
Guri never let Va'ran forget that he was in her debt, and Va'ran knew that Guri would not hesitate to [[Death/Legends|eliminate]] him and encourage the Manarai's management to fill his vacancy with [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] third-best Kubaz chef should he be uncooperative. This included requests for Va'ran to prepare sometimes the "house special," a code phrase meaning a combination of ingredients&mdash;both natural [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] seasonings and nearly untraceable chemicals&mdash;that would be added to a victim's dish throughout the meal. The [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] recipe was designed to interact with the meal's natural oils and [[Spice/Legends|spices]], as well as the victim's own digestive system, eventually resulting in painful death some [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] after ingestion.<ref name="A Very Special Meal" />

So it was that Guri came to Va'ran on one busy [[Standard day/Legends|night]] at the Manarai<ref name="A Very Special Meal" /> in [[3 ABY|3.5 ABY]]<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of the ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' multimedia project, which includes the short story "[[A Very Special Meal]]" from the ''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]'', to [[3 ABY|3.5 ABY]].</ref> with orders to secretly murder patron [[Fendrilon Koozar]], one of the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Advisors]]<ref name="A Very Special Meal" /> who had meddled in Black Sun's affairs.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|226|Koozar, Fendrilon}}</ref> Guri instructed Va'ran to give Koozar the "house special".<ref name="A Very Special Meal" />

To accommodate Guri's desire for a discreet recipe that might cause Koozar to hallucinate and plummet to his death from some great height, Va'ran considered the various chemical combinations and spices in Koozar's food and his own knowledge of [[Human/Legends|Human]] physiology. He decided to add a dose of tasteless [[thetametabuterin]] to Koozar's [[Wroonian flycatcher filet]] appetizer, a hybrid mold on his bowl of [[sufar greens]] and [[mecolar briddlings]], and some [[collafa spice]] in his main dish of [[Fleek eel/Legends|fleek-eel]] broiled in [[Zaffa oil/Legends|zaffa oil]]. Va'ran's recipe produced the desired effect&mdash;the following evening, the Master Chef saw on the [[NewsNet|newsnets]] that Koozar had been killed after throwing an uncontrollable fit while riding in his luxury [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]], seizing the controls from his [[Pilot droid/Legends|droid pilot]] and slamming the vehicle into the [[Ministry of Land Management]] in a [[Fire/Legends|fiery]] explosion.<ref name="A Very Special Meal" />

==Personality and traits==
Tavvar Va'ran was nervous about having been given the responsibility of murdering Imperial [[Advisor/Legends|Advisor]] Fendrilon Koozar on Black Sun's behalf, knowing full well that his own life hung in the balance if he did not cooperate. Thus did he obediently prepare the "house special" for Koozar on Guri's orders, nevertheless displaying an odd grimace with his [[Nose/Legends|snout]] at the thought of that poisoned recipe. Although Guri was gorgeous by Human standards, Va'ran found her unappealing, knowing what dark intentions lay masked behind her beautiful exterior.<ref name="A Very Special Meal" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tavvar Va'ran appeared in the short story "[[A Very Special Meal]]," which was written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and included in the [[1996]] ''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]'', a supplement for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="A Very Special Meal" />
